hook: Your night view here is a giant pit of fire.
title: A Desert Pit That Burns All Night
description:
The Darvaza gas crater in Turkmenistan is a pit of fire in the desert. Locals call it the Door to Hell. It is reportedly burning since 1971, though authorities have tried to reduce the flames in recent years.

#Shorts #geography #Turkmenistan
